verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents its own background automation: the Data Transfer Service schedules recurring load jobs at regular intervals, continuous queries run SQL continuously over incoming data, and Dataform schedules transformation workflows. These are recurring schedules and always-on jobs, not one-off actions. However, nothing shows AI or agent-driven automations; the Gemini and data-agent features are interactive, not autonomous background runs. Missing for 10: AI/agent-driven autonomous background tasks, a general scheduled-query/job automation surface beyond data loading and transformation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: With the BigQuery Data Transfer Service, to automate data loading pipelines into BigQuery, you can schedule load jobs.
You can schedule one-time or batch data transfers at regular intervals
BigQuery continuous queries are SQL statements that run continuously.
Dataform is a service for data analysts to develop, test, control versions, and schedule complex workflows for data transformation in BigQuery.
